announcements.headline: MindMaze Therapeutics Reports New Home-Based Rehabilitation Results Ahead of MindMotion Lite Launch
announcements.insight: MindMaze Therapeutics reports new home-based rehabilitation results ahead of MindMotion Lite launch. This follows the July enrollment in the SwissNeuroRehab study.

announcements.headline: MindMaze Therapeutics Supports University of Pittsburgh Study on a Combination Approach to Stroke Recovery, Pairing Spinal Cord Stimulation with High-Dose, High-Intensity Neurotherapy
announcements.insight: MindMaze Therapeutics supports a study following its SwissNeuroRehab enrollment. This indicates continued clinical development progress for MindMaze.

announcements.headline: MindMaze Therapeutics Enrolls First Patients in SwissNeuroRehab Study, Advancing At-Home Reimbursement Strategy in Europe
announcements.insight: This concerns MindMaze Therapeutics, not Relief Therapeutics Holding SA. The earlier AGM results are unrelated to this external news.

announcements.headline: MindMaze Therapeutics Announces Results of Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: MindMaze Therapeutics announces the results of its Annual General Meeting. This follows the earlier invitation to the 2026 AGM published in June.

announcements.headline: MindMaze Therapeutics Publishes Invitation to the 2026 Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: Relief Therapeutics Holding SA is not mentioned in this RNS. The filing concerns MindMaze Therapeutics and has no direct impact on Relief Therapeutics shareholders.
